out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: Where to Wash

violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. ALL HAND WASHING MUST BE PERFORMED IN A DESIGNATED HAND SINK.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM MOVED FOODS TO NEIGHBORING UNIT TO FACILITATE FASTER COOLING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 3 DR UC OBSERVED AT 44F - INTERIOR WAS NOT SUFFICIENTLY COLD TO TOUCH, WALK IN COOLER THERMOSTAT OBSERVED AT 55F - UNIT IS FREQUENTLY OPENED THROUGHOUT DAY.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF DEBRIS ON FLOORS, WALLS, CEILINGS OF KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM WILL CLEAN ALL FLOORS, WALLS, CEILINGS. CLEAN BEHIND, UNDERNEATH, BETWEEN EQUIPMENT.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: several TCS pastries observed with date prepared >7 days from 1/12/26 in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM stated all pastries are sold within 7 days and clarified observed pastries were made in past 7 days. CFM will remind staff to update date prepared when storing pastries on baking sheets in WIC.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: various spices, seasonings in secondary squeeze bottles and containers.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label secondary squeeze bottles and containers with food name.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed box of butter and margarine on floor underneath prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM moved food to shelf.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Observed hot water at 3 compartment sink with maximum temperature of 88F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. CFM contacted plumber. EHS will follow up on or around 10 days to verify hot water at 3 compartment sink is 110F.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed floor throughout back kitchen, especially under prep tables, with food splatter/debris.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will clean floors of back kitchen. Clean underneath and behind equipment and prep tables. O bread (Inspection Date: 01/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the register is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. Observed sheet pan on stand in front of hand washing sink at registers.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. Employee moved sheet pan and stand to clear access to hand washing sink.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no soap at hand sink at registers.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. Employee stated hand soap recently ran out. Replace hand soap.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: in #5 - mini cheesecake at 64F, in #3 -Cobb salad at 64F, garden salad at 66F, southwest salad at 66F, rolled omelet sandwich at 64F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS discussed proper use of refrigeration units for cold holding. Mini cheesecake in #5 observed in unit on top of plate and entire bottom of refrigeration floor covered with cloth. EHS and chef observed #3 unable to keep cold holding temperature of 41F or below. Mini cheesecake, Cobb salad, garden salad, southwest salad, rolled omelet sandwich will be discarded at 1030AM.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: pastries in WIC with sheet pan datemarked 6/28 and 6/30.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Chef stated foods will be discarded that day.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): all TCS pastries and breads on display. EHS observed log from 08/2024 with 4 hour time from 9:00AM-1:00PM and 1:00PM-5:00PM. Establishment opens at 8:00AM and employee stated foods are placed on display earlier than 8:00AM.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. EHS will discuss with owner proper use of TPHC and have them provide updated list of TCS pastries and breads. Time frame and dates on log must be updated to reflect actual time frame and date temperatures and times food is being displayed and discarded.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed residential hanging pest strip in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS instructed employee to immediately discard test strip. Call your licensed pest control service for any ongoing pest issues.

violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food.
